description: This file defines the interface and factory for the IMediaPipelineCapabilitiesModuleService in the Rialto media server IPC layer. It includes class declarations, method signatures for client connection management, and references to external dependencies related to media pipeline capabilities.

classes.name: IMediaPipelineCapabilitiesModuleServiceFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of IMediaPipelineCapabilitiesModuleService.

classes.name: IMediaPipelineCapabilitiesModuleService
classes.description: Interface for media pipeline capabilities module service, including connection management methods.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a new IMediaPipelineCapabilitiesModuleServiceFactory instance.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to an IMediaPipelineCapabilitiesModuleService, given a media pipeline service reference.

methods.name: clientConnected
methods.description: Handles logic when a client connects to the IPC service.

methods.name: clientDisconnected
methods.description: Handles logic when a client disconnects from the IPC service.
